art_instructions: Draw a cheerful scene of Panda and Dinosaur playing together outdoors near Panda's forest cottage. Use a Korean aegyo cute style with chibi proportions (2–3 heads tall) and rounded silhouettes. Panda, a small toddler-sized character, stands on the left side of the image, facing right towards Dinosaur. She has a round face with large black ear tufts, dark eye patches, a white muzzle, and bright, wide eyes showing happiness. Her short plush limbs are in a playful pose—perhaps arms upraised or reaching toward Dinosaur. Dinosaur, also child-sized, is on the right side, facing Panda with a big friendly smile. He has smooth pea-green scales, a pale mint belly, a round snout, and large expressive eyes. His posture is upright and engaged, with stubby arms open in invitation or motion. Both characters should be clearly happy; consider adding blush dots and happy expressions. Place them against a simple, airy background with soft gradients and gentle patterns like grass or flowers. Position the camera at eye level with a medium shot to show both characters interacting.
